title: Verify cyclic sieving for descents and complementation

source.citation: Cyclic sieving on permutations -- an analysis of maps and statistics in the FindStat database, arXiv:2402.16251

translation.notes: The paper's width-one descent theorem is specialized to S4 under complementation. Exact enumeration produces 1+11q+11q^2+q^3; its values at the two roots of unity equal the fixed-point counts 24 and 0.
